result: pass after three defects, on the fourth attempt

startup_assertions.note: reports/m3-tokenize-report.json predicted exactly these from the realised parquet.

defects_found.what: --report_to none is rejected; the only choice is wandb.
finetune.py raised AttributeError: 'Namespace' object has no attribute 'with_tracking'.
defects_found.cause: args.with_tracking was assigned only inside `if args.report_to is not None`, so any run without W&B crashed at line 601 before the first step.
defects_found.impact: the training path could not run at all without W&B configured, which is why it had never been executed
defects_found.fix: set it unconditionally; regression test in tests/test_finetune_args.py

defects_found.what: CUDA out of memory on 2x A100 80GB with the stock ZeRO-3 config.
measured: stock config: 74.44 GiB allocated of 79.25, 2.48 GiB lost to fragmentation
tightened gathers + expandable_segments: fragmentation gone (189 MiB reserved-unallocated) and still OOM at 76.93 GiB
defects_found.cause: ZeRO-3 + fp16 + AdamW is 16 bytes/param resident = 133.94 GB, i.e. 66.97 GB per card of a 79.25 GiB budget, leaving too little for activations and gathers.
defects_found.fix: offload the optimiser states to host RAM (ds_configs/zero3-fp16-offload-act_ckpt.json). They are 12 bytes/param = 100.46 GB, so roughly 50 GB per card is freed. The M3 plan named host RAM as the reason not to do this; this instance has 1316 GiB available, so it does not bind.

checkpoint.note: Exactly the 12 bytes/param the plan derived from the deepspeed source. Five checkpoints are 502 GB, comfortably inside the 900 GB disk (751 GB free with one on disk).

throughput.cost_of_offload: Steps are far slower than the 28 minutes for 65 steps the past experiment recorded without offload.
throughput.verdict: The planned 6.6 h no longer holds. At 80-110 s/step the session lands inside the 9.0 h stop line; at 141 s/step it does not. The run is watched against the stop line rather than assumed to fit.

why_this_step_exists: Two steps on an instance already running cost about US$0.20 each. The same three failures inside a 45-step run would have cost the run.
